description: Complete a batch by logging final hatch count, calculating stats, and optionally creating a bird batch. ALWAYS ask for confirmation before writing.

confirm.description: Set to true to commit, false for dry-run preview

createBirdBatch.description: Automatically log as an active bird batch census (defaults to false)

hatchedCount.description: Number of successfully hatched chicks (positive integer <= eggsSet)

location.description: Optional location for bird batch (Brooder, etc. defaults to Brooder)

name: log_hatch_result
